property_summary: For any caller and any block timestamp progression, the original contract never allows two successful fallback invocations within the same block (a second same-block call reverts), whereas the mutant that removes the time-order check allows a second same-block payable fallback call of 10 ether to succeed; the test fuzzes caller and block timestamp to expose this difference.
change_summary: Remove the time-order requirement so calls are no longer reverted due to block timestamp not being greater than pastBlockTime.
